title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Guy Who Travels
text:
This restaurant was quite lovely. They responded quickly when I asked for a reservation and the server was helpful when picking food to try. The main course was good and we enjoyed the desert.

We recommend the terrace which has a good view of the city.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Sara Correia
text: Great experience, definitely the place to go to in this city. The food was perfect and the service was the kindest, they moved us from the rooftop once it started raining, and they offered us more meat when we were surprised that the tenderloin was quite small. Especially the waiter Ismail was so nice and welcoming, we felt truly happy to be there. I did not take pictures of the food because we were starving but trust me, it looked great. The whole restaurant was beautiful too. Don’t miss it! ⭐️

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Alexandra Cowley
text:
I was staying in a neighbouring hostel and saw a group with amazing looking food and drink here, so I went to check it out. The menu is delightful and the food was delicious with excellent portion sizes. The drinks are also very tasty and the terrace roof has a great view for sunsets.
The food and staff were so good that I went again the next day, where I was greeted by the owner and got special recommendations on the menu. The entire place is very well decorated and gives a luxurious feel without the “luxurious prices”. If I’m ever back in that city, I’ll definitely eat at that restaurant again.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Mo Metwally
text: The lunch was delicious just like homemade food. I appreciated the authentic taste and quality. The atmosphere was wonderful, with beautiful décor. The service was excellent, and everyone was welcoming and attentive. Everything about this place really exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend it.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: alisha kumar
text: The first restaurant we went to since arriving at Chefchaouen. Food, ambiance, & service by Mohammed was amazing. Highly recommend. One of the best restaurants from our Morocco trip.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Pablo Salazar
text: food was definitely one of the best I’ve had in Morocco. great customer service and really cool interior. Definitely stop by if you’re in Chefchaouen

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Cynia Manning
text: Kamal is a great manager. He was super welcoming and his staff took great care of us. We were seated and helped to the rooftop and the food came out in a timely manner. They also have beautiful indoor dining. I’d 100% recommend this place.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Yuki Wong
text: Enjoyed our dinner at the rooftop with stunning views. Food was great and excellent service. Highly recommended !

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: KayVan
text:
Without a doubt, Bacha Rouge Restaurant is hands down the best dining experience in Chefchaouen! From start to finish, every single dish exceeded our expectations. The burrata salad was wonderfully fresh and vibrant, the chicken pastilla hit the perfect balance of savory and sweet, and the lamb shank was so tender it practically melted off the bone. Even their burger was outstanding and cooked to perfection.
A special shoutout to Ismail, who made the entire evening unforgettable—he is genuinely the best guide you could ask for when navigating the menu, offering thoughtful recommendations and warm hospitality. If you are visiting Chefchaouen, do not miss this place. Highly, highly recommend!

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Lala Taghiyeva
text: It is very nice place with good ambiance. We watched sunset there and it was magical. Food is really delicious. Special thanks to hosts Ismail and Kamal!

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Chama chaima
text: Absolutely amazing! The lunch was incredibly delicious—every dish was full of flavor and tasted fresh, just like homemade food. As a Moroccan girl, I truly appreciated the authentic taste and quality. The atmosphere was wonderful, with beautiful décor, great music, and a warm, relaxing vibe. The service was excellent, and everyone was welcoming and attentive. Everything about this place exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend it, and I can’t wait to come back!

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Ashlee Booker
text: Incredible indoor seating and an impressive terrace. I recommend going an hour before sunset for a spectacular view of the hills. We had starters, mains, and desserts - everything was delicious, there was attentive service, and reasonably priced for an exceptional dining experience.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: David Yin
text: Great service! Nice views. The gentleman was very kind to give me jacket when cold 😊

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Brittany Tool
text: Absolutely amazing food and service. Couldn’t ask for more. It’s about a five minute walk away from the main plaza which gives it a relaxing atmosphere without all the noise. None of the places at the plaza come close to this place. Everything was clean and the interior as well as the rooftop are beautifully designed. The waiters speak English and are very attentive and friendly. We have already been there twice during our trip and plan to go back again before we leave.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Alex Burba
text: Cool looking place with great food!

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Tyrone Pope
text: Great views of the city on the rooftop. The inside has amazing and wall art and pictures that you must see! The manager and staff are welcoming, communicate well, and provide excellent customer service.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Imane R
text: Good food , good service and a beautifully decorated place.

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: WOLFS SQUADS
text: A complete experience in every aspect, the first suitable place, we did not find it difficult to find, and when we entered, it was a welcome from everyone, the receptionist was classy, smiling, and a waiter, so he had a wonderful spirit and energy, they had a great place to sit, but the food, we say thank you for the hands that I cooked, it was excellent, thank you to everyone, and we will definitely return ❤️🤝

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Marten Riehl
text: Great food, quiet place and they don’t lurk outside the place to get you inside the restaurant like many other restaurants in the Medina

title: Bacha Rouge Restaurant
name: Christine Wong
text: A relaxing rooftop for the beautiful sunset. It shared the same view as the Spanish Mosque. Staff are all friendly and attentive. Fish tajine is tasty.
